companions.label: cut lane
companions._note: The renderer the write verbs enqueue for. Without it, stabilize and cut-retry ACCEPT work that nothing ever performs: the verb returns ok, a real marker lands on disk, and no cut is ever rendered. That is Ruling 16's third rung — it defeats both the verbs-answer check AND the data-changed-on-disk check, because the write genuinely happens and only the EFFECT is absent. Declared so the box starts it WITH the provider instead of someone remembering to.

_serves_note: BYTE-route prefixes, matched by prefix — a backend is not only its /api/ verbs. THREE of these were already declared by the app; `/master/` WAS NOT, and that was a live dead button on every studio. cutdown.html:468 points the download-full control at `/master/<file>` and cutdown-server.mjs:335 answers it, but with nothing declaring the prefix studio.mjs:474 finds no match, :475 skips it (the sole-provider fallback covers /api/ ONLY) and :479 hands it to the SDK runtime, which 404s. Second instance of this exact class found in one day, after /canvas-license.json. The pattern is worth naming: a byte route is easy to add to a server and easy to forget in a manifest, because nothing fails at build time and the surface that calls it looks correct.
_verbs_note: All eight, and unlike studio-video nothing is withheld: measured against the handlers in cutdown-server.mjs, the server answers exactly these eight and no more. It contains no `rig queue create` and no `open -R`, so there is no capability here that declaring would newly expose.
_supplies_note: Binaries this package SHIPS (ffmpeg-static/ffprobe-static) so the host need not have them. The app still declares the NEED in requires.binaries — that stays true and legible; this says who satisfies it. Load-bearing for this provider specifically: the cut lane cannot render anything without them, and most target boxes have no system ffmpeg.
_why_this_file_exists: The run spec, its companion and the byte routes lived on apps/cutdown/app.json, which meant a capability of the PACKAGE was declared by a CONSUMER of it. This repo has already paid for that shape once: retiring the AGENTS app removed the only declaration of {{state}} and a deployed box served an invented rig under a green live signal. Cutdown was one app away from the same story — the cut lane is declared here now, so retiring the cutdown app can no longer take the renderer with it.
